tickets.text: My position system adds 50/30/20 on each new buy signal while the trade proves right (C30), with no distance cap. Yes once the impulse confirms (TIF partial, COM proxy unserved).

The trigger waits for a pullback toward the pivot. A name already through resistance is a position-system signal (C26); my entry is trade above bar_high, trailed to each new prior-day high (C27), with no pullback asked for.

horizon_sessions 10 is short for a position trade (more than two weeks, C22); my exits are a close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d) or the trend-colour flip, never the clock (C29). The price break of bar_high is my entry (C27).

The trigger requires a pullback that holds the broken level first. A break above resistance is the position-system entry itself (C26); asking for a pullback skips the signal my criteria generate (C19).
The trigger requires a pullback that holds the broken level first. In the position system the break is the entry (C26); a pullback precondition skips the signal my criteria generate (C19).

The trigger waits for a quiet pullback into the broken level. D 5.7% past the swing high is a position-system case where extension is not a fault (C26); my entry is trade above bar_high, trailed (C27).
A pullback toward the 20-day average is a swing-system entry (C3) put on a position-system picture (D 20.8% above the last swing high, new high). Never judge a position case by swing rules (R10).
A pullback toward the 20-day average is a swing-system entry (C3) put on a position-system picture (D 15.7% above the last swing high). Extension is not a fault in the position system (C26, R10).
